# SalkarsaUI

> Mobile-first design system with 33 components, 959 icons and 552 design tokens for light and dark themes, plus usage rules for developers and AI coding tools.

## Docs
- [DESIGN.md](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/salahudinalyb/SalkarsaUI/main/DESIGN.md): The full guide, covering rules, tokens, components and their props, patterns and accessibility
- [AGENTS.md](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/salahudinalyb/SalkarsaUI/main/AGENTS.md): A short list of do's and don'ts for coding agents

## Tokens
- [tokens.css](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/salahudinalyb/SalkarsaUI/main/tokens/tokens.css): CSS custom properties with light/dark themes, shadows and text classes
- [tokens.json](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/salahudinalyb/SalkarsaUI/main/tokens/tokens.json): W3C DTCG tokens with descriptions
